parse.title: Mysteries
parse.wikitext:
The land of [[Tibia]] holds a lot of mysteries. Some riddles have answers, others not. Research methods usually start by reading [[Library|books]] and conversating with [[NPCs]], as well as exploring the map looking for clues. Many mysteries are related to or revolved around reaching [[Unreachable Locations]], [[Unreachable Creatures]] or obtaining [[Unobtainable Items]]. There is also a list of [[Odd Places]] which may or may not be connected to any mystery. 

This page lists several mysteries that exist in Tibia. For more information on each of them, visit the linked pages. 

== 469 ==

The ''Bonelord Language'', [[469]], has never been translated. Do all the books written in this language mean anything, or are them just random numbers?

== Basilisk ==

Is it possible to reach the NPC [[Basilisk]], and does it give any mission, reward or even information? 

== Babel Swimmer ==

Is it possible to create a [[Babel Swimmer]] from a [[Shimmer Swimmer]]?

== Level 999 island ==

The level 999 island, also known as [[Schrödinger's Island]], is reachable through [[Deeper Banuta]]. Some players believe there's more to the island than simply getting the trophy once you go there for the first time. 

== Troll Lady ==

During the [[Troll Sabotage Quest]], [[Chief Grarkharok]] asks the player to help him find a ''Troll Lady'', but she was never found. 

== Serpentine Tower ==

Besides obtaining the [[White Pearl]], many players believe it's possible to advance further into the [[Serpentine Tower Quest]] after releasing the creatures from their cages. What does the [[Green Djinn]] lever do? 

== Variphor ==

This ''entity'' seems to be a powerful force that has had great impact in [[Tibia]], but information about [[Variphor]] is scarce and the places where it has appeared are often connected to death, corruption and destruction.

== Warlord Sword ==

[[A Sweaty Cyclops]] claims to be able to craft this sword if you provide him with the materials to make it. These materials, however, remain unknown. 

== Years of Serpents ==

The northern [[Ice Islands]] were discovered and old ship routes were restored because the [[Sea Serpent]]s moved away. Why did they move away? 

{{Seealso|Years of Serpents}}

== Zao Corruption ==

A corruption spreads throughout [[Zao]], but what is the cause of this corruption? This corruption has also affected the [[Order of the Falcon]] and was responsible for their demise. Is it the same [[The Source of Corruption|Source of Corruption]] of the [[Cults of Tibia Quest]]?
